source.source_family: OpenStreetMap data retrieved via Overpass API
source.license_and_attribution: The raw Overpass responses state that the data is from www.openstreetmap.org and made available under ODbL; attribution is required.
source.interpretation: This is a timestamped public-data screening source. OSM proximity or geometry overlap is an observation for manual review; it does not prove surveyed crossing, right-of-way, clearance, hydrology, route feasibility, or construction alignment. A no-feature result is not proof of absence because OSM coverage and tagging can be incomplete.
source.coordinate_method: WGS84 to existing EPSG:32649 series; polygon topology and approximate metre distances, not an independent geodetic registration

limitations: 30m is a screening threshold, not engineering clearance.
OSM absence is not proof of absence.
Facility checks apply to seed anchors and actual display pads, not surveyed footprints.
Inside-water observations concern the public snapshot, not a determination of current legal shoreline.
Surveyed controls, tolerances, vertical correction, right-of-way and construction methods remain required.
